interest: Index on suspected Japanese espionage disguised as fishing off Ceylon.
overview: Docket on 1936 Japanese subversion in Ceylon: Consul Buell's reports and the capture of Japanese poachers aboard the Taikya Maru.

subfiles.about: A Department of State 'List of Papers' docket sheet indexing despatches from the American Consulate in Colombo regarding Japanese subversive operations and poaching in Ceylon.
subfiles.summary: Indexes 1936 Colombo despatches on suspected Japanese subversion and the capture of poachers on the Taikya Maru.
